verdict.rationale: The evidence documents Experiment management APIs usable from CI and scripts, SDKs, an OpenAPI spec, llms.txt and an official MCP server, but nothing shows an official command-line tool. APIs and MCP are adjacent building blocks, not a CLI, so they earn no credit. An official CLI is a fair axis for an experimentation platform, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
